name: Accordion
description: A list of accordion items, where each item opens to show its content.

name: AccordionContent
description: The content of an accordion item.

name: AccordionItem
description: One entry of an accordion: a title that opens to show its content.

name: Anchor
description: A named position in the page content that links can jump to.

name: BasicStage
description: A stage with a media background, a heading, text and call to action buttons.

name: BillboardTeaser
description: A teaser across the full width, with a media background, a heading, text and call to action buttons.

name: CallToAction
description: A link that is shown as a button, in one of the button variants.

name: CallToActionList
description: A list of call to action buttons.

name: Columns
description: Content next to each other in columns, in one of the predefined column layouts.

name: ColumnsContent
description: The content of one column.

name: ContactForm
description: A contact form that visitors can use to get in touch.

name: ContentGroup
description: A group of blocks that share a background color.

name: ContentGroupContent
description: The content of a content group.

name: DamFileDownloadLink
description: A link to a file from the Digital Asset Management. The file is either opened in a new tab or downloaded.

name: DamImage
description: An image from the Digital Asset Management, either a pixel image or an SVG.

name: DamVideo
description: A video file from the Digital Asset Management, with a preview image and playback settings.

name: EmailCampaignContent
description: The content of an email campaign.

name: EmailCampaignSalutation
description: The salutation of an email campaign, filled with the name of the recipient.

name: EmailLink
description: A link that opens a new email to the given address.

name: ExternalLink
description: A link to a URL outside of this application.

name: FooterContent
description: The content of the site footer: text, an image with a caption, a link list and a copyright notice.

name: FullWidthImage
description: An image across the full width of the page, with optional text on top of it.

name: Heading
description: A headline with an eyebrow text above it, rendered with the chosen HTML heading tag.

name: InternalLink
description: A link to another page of the page tree, optionally to an anchor on that page.

name: KeyFacts
description: A list of key facts.

name: KeyFactsItem
description: One key fact: an icon, the fact itself, its label and a description.

name: Layout
description: Two media and two texts, arranged in one of the predefined layouts.

name: Link
description: A link whose target is one of the supported link blocks, for instance a page of the page tree or an external URL.

name: LinkList
description: A list of text links, each of them shown to one user group.

name: MailButton
description: A link that is shown as a button in an email.

name: MailDivider
description: A horizontal line between two blocks of an email.

name: MailImage
description: An image in an email, optionally across the full width.

name: MailLink
description: A link in an email, either to an external URL or to a phone number.

name: MailSpacer
description: Vertical space between two blocks of an email.

name: MailTwoListSizesRichText
description: Formatted text for emails, with two list sizes to choose from.

name: Media
description: An image or a video, either from the Digital Asset Management or from YouTube or Vimeo.

name: MediaGallery
description: A gallery of images and videos, all shown in the same aspect ratio.

name: MediaGalleryItem
description: One item of a media gallery: an image or a video with an optional caption.

name: MediaGalleryList
description: The items of a media gallery.

name: NewsContent
description: The content of a news entry.

name: NewsDetail
description: The detail view of a single news entry.

name: NewsletterImage
description: An image in the content of an email campaign.

name: NewsLink
description: A link to a news entry.

name: NewsList
description: A list of the selected news entries.

name: OptionalPixelImage
description: An optional PixelImage block. Its content is only used while it is enabled.

name: OptionalRichText
description: An optional RichText block. Its content is only used while it is enabled.

name: PageContent
description: The content of a page, as the list of blocks it is built from.

name: PageTreeIndex
description: A list of the pages below the current page in the page tree.

name: PhoneLink
description: A link that dials the given phone number.

name: PixelImage
description: An image file from the Digital Asset Management, together with the crop area the editor has chosen.

name: ProductList
description: A list of the products of the selected types.

name: ProductPrice
description: The current price of a product, loaded from the product itself.

name: ProductTeaser
description: A teaser for a single product.

name: RedirectsLink
description: The target a redirect points to, for instance a page of the page tree or an external URL.

name: RichText
description: Formatted text, edited in the Draft.js based rich text editor.

name: RichText
description: Formatted text, edited in the Draft.js based rich text editor.

name: Seo
description: The metadata of a page for search engines and social networks: title, description, preview image, sitemap settings and canonical URL.

name: Slider
description: A slider that shows its slides one after another.

name: SliderItem
description: One slide of a slider: a media with text.

name: SliderList
description: The slides of a slider.

name: Space
description: Vertical space between two blocks, as a height in pixels.

name: Space
description: Vertical space between two blocks, in one of the spacings the application offers.

name: Stage
description: The stages at the top of a page.

name: StandaloneCallToActionList
description: A list of call to action buttons placed directly in the page content, with its alignment.

name: StandaloneHeading
description: A heading placed directly in the page content, with the alignment of its text.

name: StandaloneMedia
description: A media placed directly in the page content, shown in the chosen aspect ratio.

name: StandaloneRichText
description: Rich text placed directly in the page content, with the alignment of its text.

name: SvgImage
description: An SVG file from the Digital Asset Management.

name: Table
description: A table whose cells contain rich text.

name: Teaser
description: A list of teasers.

name: TeaserItem
description: One teaser: a media, a title, a description and a link.

name: TextImage
description: Rich text with an image beside it, either on the left or on the right.

name: TextLink
description: A link together with the text that is shown for it.

name: TipTapRichText
description: Formatted text that can also contain a product price or a product teaser.

name: TipTapTable
description: A table whose cells contain TipTap rich text.

name: VimeoVideo
description: A video hosted on Vimeo, with a preview image and playback settings.

name: WelcomeEmailContent
description: The content of the welcome email.

name: YouTubeVideo
description: A video hosted on YouTube, with a preview image and playback settings.
